title: One merge verdict serves lane status, prune and Stop
body:
Astra audit C6 (verified): lane status calls a lane merged when any old ship SHA is an ancestor of the base (src/cli/lane-status.ts:58, lane.ts:166-171) and maps every non-MERGED PR state, including CLOSED, to pr-open (lane-status.ts:71); prune (lane.ts:282-296) also requires tipBelongsToRecord and Stop (src/hook/stop.ts:1158) checks head and branch. Three callers, three merge verdicts.
Files: src/cli/lane-status.ts, src/cli/lane.ts, src/hook/stop.ts, test/cli/lane-merge-verdict.test.ts
Outcome: one exported function decides merged/pr-open/closed/unshipped from (repo, task, head, PR state); lane status, prune and Stop call it; a fixture that advances the branch after a successful ship gets the same verdict from all three.
Proof: node --test test/cli/lane-merge-verdict.test.ts passes, including the advanced-branch and closed-PR cases.
